card.title: For Their Own Good
card.instruction: Take charge of another person's choices because you trust your judgment more than theirs. Frame control as care.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've ordered you the mild curry. You're welcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's exactly the impulse I'm protecting you from.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I will come with you. Someone needs to explain what you really want.
